params.name: U
params.let: a1 if a1 > a2 else a2

params.name: V
params.let: b1 if a1 > a2 else b2

params.name: U2
params.let: a2 if a1 > a2 else a1

params.name: V2
params.let: b2 if a1 > a2 else b1

params.why: contact points must have different x-coordinates

stem: The point $({=P1}, {=P2})$ lies outside the circle $x^2+y^2={=R}$. Two tangents are drawn from this point to the circle. Find the equation of the tangent whose point of contact has the greater $x$-coordinate.
solution: Let the point of contact be $(a, b)$. It lies on the circle, so $a^2+b^2={=R}$.
The tangent at $(a, b)$ is $ax+by={=R}$. It passes through $({=P1}, {=P2})$, so ${=P1}a+({=P2})b={=R}$.
Solving these two equations gives the points of contact $({=U}, {=V})$ and $({=U2}, {=V2})$. Check: ${=U}^2+({=V})^2={=R}$ and ${=U2}^2+({=V2})^2={=R}$.
The greater $x$-coordinate is {=U}, so the point of contact is $({=U}, {=V})$.
Use $ax+by=r^2$ at $({=U}, {=V})$: ${=U}x{=sg}{=abs(V)}y={=R}$. (The other tangent, at $({=U2}, {=V2})$, is ${=U2}x{=sg2}{=abs(V2)}y={=R}$.)
notes: Advanced: external point. Contact points are lattice points, built from reflections of 3 base cases (checked: P on both tangents, contacts on circle). Asking for the greater-x contact gives a single answer.
